note: Named starting points for the built-in synth. THE single source of truth for both halves of the app: the Rust proof (engine/agent-surface/tests/instrument_tone.rs) renders every preset in this file through the real command bus and asserts they sound different from each other and from the default, and the Swift table (src/swift/Sources/Studio/StudioInstrumentModel.swift, StudioInstrumentPreset.all) is asserted equal to this file byte for byte by StudioSamplerUITests. Neither side may edit its own copy alone. Each 'params' entry is a device.param.set (trackId, deviceId, key, value) on the track's instrument; keys are DEVICE_PARAM_KEYS (timeline-core/src/model.rs) and a key that is ABSENT here reads as the DSP default, because instrument params are sparse. waveform is 0 sine / 1 saw / 2 square / 3 triangle.
honesty: None of these is a sampled acoustic instrument. This app ships no instrument samples at all — the sounds vault is drum one-shots and stems — so 'Electric Piano' is a synthesized approximation of an electric piano and is named as one. Nothing here is called 'Piano'.

presets.name: Electric Piano
presets.blurb: Bell-like and percussive. Loudest the instant you press the key, then it fades on its own — like a struck key rather than a held note.

presets.name: Soft Pad
presets.blurb: Slow and warm. It swells in over about half a second and hangs on after you let go, so a held chord becomes a bed for everything else.

presets.name: Pluck
presets.blurb: Short and bright, like a plucked string. Gone in a fifth of a second however long you hold the key, so fast parts stay clear instead of turning to mush.

presets.name: Bass
presets.blurb: Dark and round, made for the bottom two octaves. The bright half of the sound is filtered away so it sits under everything else instead of fighting it.

presets.name: Organ
presets.blurb: Holds dead steady for as long as you hold the key, and stops almost the moment you let go. No fade in, no fade out — the sound is either on or off.
